# Errors

Every non-2xx response is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document:

```json
{
  "type": "…/docs/errors.md#no-such-anchor",
  "title": "Human-readable summary",
  "status": 404,
  "code": "MACHINE_READABLE_CODE",
  "detail": "What specifically went wrong."
}
```

Branch on `code`, never on `detail` — `detail` names the specific input and
changes between requests. Some codes carry additional members, listed below.

| Code | Status | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`](#route-not-found) | 404 | The path is not registered. |
| [`INTERNAL_ERROR`](#internal-error) | 500 | An unhandled exception reached the error boundary. |
| [`INVALID_QUERY`](#invalid-query) | 422 | A query parameter is missing, malformed, or outside its allowed range. |
| [`PERSON_NOT_FOUND`](#person-not-found) | 404 | The person id does not resolve. |
| [`NO_TRANSITION_FOR_PLAYER`](#no-transition-for-player) | 404 | The person exists but never changed league, so there is nothing to backtest against. |
| [`MODEL_VERSION_NOT_FOUND`](#model-version-not-found) | 404 | The requested model version is not in the registry. |
| [`NO_PREDICTIONS_FOR_FILTER`](#no-predictions-for-filter) | 404 | The direction and metric combination has no fitted predictions. |
| [`NO_PROJECTIONS`](#no-projections) | 404 | No player satisfies the direction, season and support filters together. |
| [`NO_ARCHETYPE_FOR_PLAYER`](#no-archetype-for-player) | 404 | The player has no season clearing the minutes floor the archetype model requires. |
| [`NO_COMPS_FOR_PLAYER`](#no-comps-for-player) | 404 | The player has no archetype assignment, so there is no space to find neighbours in. |
| [`NO_SHOOTING_FOR_PLAYER`](#no-shooting-for-player) | 404 | The player has no season above the three-point attempt floor. |
| [`NO_SHOOTING_FOR_SEASON`](#no-shooting-for-season) | 404 | The season carries no player above the attempt floor, or is not in the snapshot. |
| [`NO_REPORT_FOR_PLAYER`](#no-report-for-player) | 404 | No report has been generated for this player and season. |
| [`UNDER_RECONSTRUCTION`](#under-reconstruction) | 501 | The path previously returned fabricated values and has been withdrawn until real output backs it. |
| [`METRIC_WITHDRAWN`](#metric-withdrawn) | 410 | The underlying quantity cannot be computed from public data at all. |

## route-not-found

**`ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`** — 404 No such endpoint

The path is not registered.

GET / lists every endpoint and its state.

Additional members: `listing`.

## internal-error

**`INTERNAL_ERROR`** — 500 Internal error

An unhandled exception reached the error boundary.

Quote the request_id. It is on the response and on the structured log line for the failure.

Additional members: `request_id`.

## invalid-query

**`INVALID_QUERY`** — 422 Invalid query parameters

A query parameter is missing, malformed, or outside its allowed range.

`detail` names each offending parameter and why it was rejected.

## person-not-found

**`PERSON_NOT_FOUND`** — 404 No such person

The person id does not resolve.

Search by name at /players/search; ids are not guessable.

Additional members: `search`.

## no-transition-for-player

**`NO_TRANSITION_FOR_PLAYER`** — 404 No observed league transition

The person exists but never changed league, so there is nothing to backtest against.

This is the common case — most players never move. /projections serves the counterfactual instead.

## model-version-not-found

**`MODEL_VERSION_NOT_FOUND`** — 404 No such model version

The requested model version is not in the registry.

GET /models lists every version this deployment can serve.

Additional members: `registry`.

## no-predictions-for-filter

**`NO_PREDICTIONS_FOR_FILTER`** — 404 No predictions match that filter

The direction and metric combination has no fitted predictions.

`directions` lists the combinations that do.

Additional members: `directions`.

## no-projections

**`NO_PROJECTIONS`** — 404 No projections match that filter

No player satisfies the direction, season and support filters together.

Widen the season floor, or drop inSupportOnly.

## no-archetype-for-player

**`NO_ARCHETYPE_FOR_PLAYER`** — 404 No archetype assignment

The player has no season clearing the minutes floor the archetype model requires.

Low-minute seasons are excluded rather than clustered on noise.

## no-comps-for-player

**`NO_COMPS_FOR_PLAYER`** — 404 No comparables

The player has no archetype assignment, so there is no space to find neighbours in.

See NO_ARCHETYPE_FOR_PLAYER.

## no-shooting-for-player

**`NO_SHOOTING_FOR_PLAYER`** — 404 No shooting estimate

The player has no season above the three-point attempt floor.

Below the floor the estimate would be almost entirely prior, so none is served.

## no-shooting-for-season

**`NO_SHOOTING_FOR_SEASON`** — 404 No shooting estimates for that season

The season carries no player above the attempt floor, or is not in the snapshot.

The hosted demo serves a slice; a local run carries every season.

## no-report-for-player

**`NO_REPORT_FOR_PLAYER`** — 404 No scouting report

No report has been generated for this player and season.

Reports are pre-generated for the evaluation set rather than written on demand, because generating one costs money and could not then be checked.

## under-reconstruction

**`UNDER_RECONSTRUCTION`** — 501 Endpoint under reconstruction

The path previously returned fabricated values and has been withdrawn until real output backs it.

`will_serve` states what it will return and `blocked_on` names the phase that unblocks it.

Additional members: `endpoint`, `will_serve`, `blocked_on`, `previously`, `roadmap`.

## metric-withdrawn

**`METRIC_WITHDRAWN`** — 410 Metric permanently withdrawn

The underlying quantity cannot be computed from public data at all.

`instead` names the nearest honest alternative. 410 rather than 501 is the signal: stop asking.

Additional members: `endpoint`, `instead`, `roadmap`.
